params.body:
## Why

Owner on PR 481 (merged): "waarom 2 knoppen lezen en ongelezen?" Since 481, tapping a row opens the lead and marks it read, so the eye ("lees bericht") did the same thing as opening. And with fifteen rows, read and unread should be told apart at a glance, like in a mail client. The gateway cannot update a branch, so this is a new PR on top of 481.

## What changed

`resources/views/worklist/widgets/4.blade.php` (Tailwind in the blade, no hot files):

- The eye button is gone. Two actions remain: the envelope (mark read / unread, open or closed icon, green / red) and the trash. Right of the row on `sm+`, in the opened card on a phone, as in 481.
- Unread row: dot, name semibold, name and excerpt in `text-brand-ink`. Read row: no dot, name normal weight, name / vehicle / excerpt in `text-brand-gray`. Both states are one markup: `.unread` on the `<li class="ui-lead group ...">` switches them through Tailwind's group variant (`hidden group-[.unread]:inline-block`, `font-normal group-[.unread]:font-semibold`, `text-brand-gray group-[.unread]:text-brand-ink`), so a script only flips the card's class and the whole row restyles.
- The envelope no longer reloads: `toggleLeadState(btn)` posts to the existing update route and calls `setLeadState(li, read)`, which flips `.read/.unread`, the envelope's colour, icon, `data-tip` and `aria-label` (labels from `data-label-read` / `data-label-unread`), and rewrites the count in the head. Opening an unread row calls the same `setLeadState` after its POST.
- The helper finds the envelope by `button[data-lead-state]`, not by sibling position; `toggle()` and the `fa-eye` path are removed from the script block (nothing in `resources/js` or `public/js` referenced them).
- Head: "Leads (15, 9 ongelezen)" through the new key `worklist.leads_unread` (`:count ongelezen` / `:count non lu(s)` / `:count unread` / `:count ungelesen`, all four files, `LanguageParityTest`); the unread part is hidden at zero, and the script keeps it current from the template on the `<ul data-unread-template>`.
- Hooks kept: `#widget_fold_4`, `#lead-{id}`, `.read/.unread`, `.ui-lead-links`, the update and destroy routes.

Rules P1-3.10, P1-3.11 and P1-3.12 in `31-p1-dagelijks-werk.md` describe the states, the count and the two actions.

## Verified in the browser (1440 and 390, demo dataset with 15 leads)

Opening the first unread row: POST 200, class `unread` → `read`, name computed as weight 400 in `rgb(71, 84, 103)`, head "(15, 9 ongelezen)" → "(15, 8 ongelezen)". Envelope on that row: POST 200, back to `unread`, dot visible again, tooltip "Markeren als gelezen", head back to 9. No horizontal scroll at 390, no page errors.

Screenshots: `scratchpad/leads-widget/collapsed-1440.png`, `collapsed-1440-open.png` (first lead opened and read: no dot, grey name, envelope open; the eight unread rows below with dot and semibold ink), `collapsed-390.png`, `collapsed-390-open.png` (an opened row with the message, contact line, links and the two icon buttons at the bottom of the card).

## Tests

`WorklistPageTest` (`test_a_lead_is_one_row_that_opens_to_the_question` updated: two actions, no eye, envelope by hook, callback instead of reload; new `test_a_read_lead_recedes_and_the_head_counts_the_unread`; the count assertion in the five-lists test now expects "(1, 1 ongelezen)"), `LanguageParityTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`: 28 tests, 869 assertions, one failure that is not this change (`test_the_dialog_lists_every_worklist_as_one_row_with_a_named_switch`, schema-seeded widget names on the local database; passes on an empty table as in CI). `SmokeTest` worklists pages: OK (3 tests).
params.title: Worklists: leads collapse to one line each, open on tap (replaces 481)
